pr_title: Bluetooth: Host: Fix gatt notify multi
pr_body:
This implements multiple Handle Value Notification (HVN) in one ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF PDU. Core Spec 5 .3 | Vol 3, Part F, 3.4.7.4 section describes as this new PDU allows the GATT server to send the values of two or more attributes in a single PDU in the list of tuples of (handle, len, value). However, the Zephyr host currently supports multi HVN but it does not utilize the new ATT PDU of ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF=0x23 fully. It is sending only one HVN per PDU, and it is no different from the existing regular single HVN with ATT_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF=0x1B.


Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/40664
pr_comments:
@Thalley: I tested with calling bt_gatt_notify_multiple() with 2 notify_params with data { 0x32 } and { 0x01, 0x78, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00, 0x68, 0x00} separately. Attached the snapshot of nrf sniffer log with the original zephyr host before this PR change. Open the pcap log file in Wireshark and apply "btatt" filter, then obtain the 2 ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF PDU pdus (opcode=0x23). The first PDU is with data 0x32 and the 2nd PDU is with data 0x01, 0x78, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00, 0x68, 0x00. Therefore, the log validates the issue exist, i.e., Zephyr host sends one HVN per PDU, rather than only one PDU with a list of tuples.
![test_gatt_sr_gan_bv_02_c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5789363/168286971-c46094d4-eabd-4fbb-a132-cddde306eb57.png)
![att_pdu1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5789363/168286621-e0159022-b8b9-4c4a-a373-2f5f889210a3.png)
![att_pdu2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5789363/168287205-9e39cf98-2769-4342-9606-58b6c3749410.png)

Thanks @laxiLang 

I want to take a bit closer look into this and try to reproduce it as well, as I am not convinced this PR is the right solution just yet :) My theory is that the workqueue may be running at a higher priority than the caller of `bt_gatt_notify_multiple`, which wouldn't work, but perhaps there's a simpler solution to the existing implementation. 

I won't block this PR though, and if it gets approved and merged (and it works of course) that is also fine, but I think we may have some additional cleanup from the current solution (e.g. this approach doesn't seem to need the workqueue item).

Hi @laxiLang I have confirmed the issue (used https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/45676 to test). 

I assume that the issue with the current implementation is that the workqueue is running at a higher priority than the application thread, thus when calling `bt_gatt_notify_multiple` the individual notifications are handled before the next is added to the notify multiple. 

The current implementation also has the issue that it will attempt to use multiple notifications, regardless of whether `bt_gatt_notify_multiple` or bt_gatt_notify` is called, which I guess is a bit unwanted since that adds an additional 2 octest for the `len` field. 

On the other side, the intention with the current implementation is that the API would automatically send multiple notifications in a single ATT command, which could be nice. 

The last issue that the current implement has, is that since it uses the workqueue thread, the ordering of events may be different. e.g. an application may wish to do 

1. Incoming write request
2. Update value
3. Send notification
4. Send write response

But if `3.` is offloaded to the workqueue thread, the notification may be sent after the write response. Some services or qualification tests may require the notification to be sent before the write response. 


Given the above, I'll take a proper look at your suggested fix and add some feedback.

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: GATT: EATT:  Multiple notify feature not utilize new PDU fully
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem?**
Bluetooth 5.2 introduced Multiple Handle Value Notification (HVN) sub-feature as part of Enhanced ATT feature.
Zephyr host currently supports multi HVN but it does not utilize new ATT PDU of `ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF=0x23`  fully. It is sending only one HVN per PDU, and it is no different then existing regular single HVN with `ATT_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF=0x1B`.

Core Spec 5 .3 | Vol 3, Part F, 3.4.7.4 section describes as this new PDU allows to the GATT server to send the values of two or more attributes in a single PDU in the list of tuples of `(handle, len, value)`. So this new sub-feature should be supporting multiple HVN in one PDU.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Currently, Multiple HVN is sent with `bt_gatt_notify_multiple()` API that takes list of HVN info. But it is sending them in separate PDU iterating through them. Instead, it should be sent in single PDU as much as they fits.

review_comments: It would probably make sense to do this check before doing any lookups for handles.
